assertions.reason: Stable and dev remained concurrently reachable on 3080/3081, with isolated compose projects, image tags, ports, bind mounts, and named volumes; after multiple dev-side disruptive operations, stable container identities and reachability remained unchanged.

evidence.observation: Both rails up with distinct host ports and rail-scoped services/images (stable on 3080, dev on 3081). See 01-status-all-initial.log and 18-status-all-final.log.

evidence.command: docker ps --format ...; docker volume ls --format ... | grep '^(librechat-stable_|librechat-dev_)' ; docker inspect ...
evidence.observation: Compose project labels split by librechat-stable vs librechat-dev; volume names are rail-prefixed; stable uses /uploads,/logs,/data-node while dev uses /.rails/dev/* writable mounts. See 03-isolation-artifacts-pre.log and 04-bind-mount-isolation.log.
Both rails returned HTTP 200 on root before and after dev-side operations. See 02-curl-baseline.log and 17-post-sync-from-stable-state.log.
Stable API and Mongo container IDs stayed unchanged across dev stop/export/apply/start/sync operations. See 19-stable-container-unchanged-check.log.

assertions.reason: Dev bundle export correctly refused while dev services were active, then succeeded from a stopped dev rail with metadata/hash plus all declared bind and volume archives.

evidence.observation: Exited with code 1 and explicit message: 'Dev rail must be stopped before exporting or importing state.' See 05-export-while-dev-active.log.
Stopped only dev containers before export. See 06-stop-dev.log and 07-curl-after-dev-stop.log.
Exited 0; exported 3 bind files, 5 bind dirs, 5 volumes; computed bundle hash; wrote metadata.env. See 08-export-fresh.log and 09-bundle-fresh-contents.log.

evidence.command: python3 (copy fresh bundle -> bundle-stale and set LIBRECHAT_SYNC_BASE_TOKEN to stale-token)
evidence.observation: Prepared stale incoming bundle metadata for mismatch test. See 10-create-stale-bundle.log.
Returned status=remote_newer with conflict_dir after token mismatch check. See 11-apply-stale-bundle.log.
Conflict archive exists and contains metadata plus bind/volume archives. See 21-stale-conflict-archive-check.log.

assertions.reason: A freshly exported bundle imported cleanly into stopped dev state, returned accepted, restored declared bind+volume artifacts, and left token/hash metadata aligned.

evidence.observation: Returned status=accepted; import step restored 3 bind files, 5 bind dirs, and 5 volumes. See 12-apply-fresh-bundle.log.

evidence.command: source bundle metadata + compare with /pool/home/timeng/LibreChat-custom/.local-sync/dev/current_token and authoritative metadata

evidence.observation: Dev rail started successfully after apply and served HTTP 200. See 14-start-dev.log and 17-post-sync-from-stable-state.log.

assertions.reason: sync-from-stable copied stable MongoDB and user-file state into dev, restarted only dev-side consumers, and left stable serving continuously.

evidence.observation: Ran in Local-direct mode; dumped stable Mongo, restored into dev, synced images/uploads, then restarted dev API + Meilisearch. Exit 0. See 16-sync-from-stable.log.

evidence.command: docker inspect stable/dev API and dev Meilisearch before/after sync
evidence.observation: Stable API ID and startedAt unchanged; dev API/Meilisearch startedAt moved due dev-side restart. See 15-pre-sync-from-stable-state.log and 17-post-sync-from-stable-state.log.
Stable remained reachable (200 root, 401 admin permissions) after sync while dev remained reachable/auth-gated. See 17-post-sync-from-stable-state.log.
